post.description: Requires local control.maintenance.write and the original subject. No query or body. start reserves actual completion drain and authenticates an independent helper before Host exit; admission fails when update trust or required desktop family proof is unavailable. cancel is idempotent only before handoff and creates no file-effect journal. CLI: maintenance-start or maintenance-cancel --id <uuid>. Not exposed through MCP.

200.description: Cancelled pending operation; response shape matches maintenance-operation.json

202.description: Starting operation; query by original operation identity. This is not a successful candidate receipt.

403.description: Origin, remote source or capability rejected

409.description: Current lifecycle, operation state, ownership or trusted inputs prevent handoff
